risks.risk: Product identity is completely unresolved (AliExpress SKU 1005011889868887) - quality, legality, shipping class, and market fit cannot be assessed at all
risks.mitigation: Do not commit any budget; obtain the exact listing via AliExpress app share-link, image search, or supplier chat before deciding anything

risks.risk: Committing to a 100-unit batch of an unidentified item risks total capital loss if it proves low-demand, illegal, or undeliverable
risks.mitigation: Skip this product or cut to a minimum viable sample (10-20 units) until identity is confirmed

risks.risk: Unknown category could fall into a restricted/controlled import class (e.g. medical device, weapon-adjacent item, counterfeit electronics), risking customs seizure
risks.mitigation: Verify HS code and product photos before any customs declaration is filed

risks.risk: No compliant ad creative can be built without knowing what is being sold, risking vague or misleading Arabic ads that get flagged by Meta review
risks.mitigation: Withhold any ad campaign creation until the product is identified

P01.top_risk: The product's identity itself is unknown, making every other risk dimension unassessable before committing capital.

risks.risk: Shapewear/fajas is a textbook saturated global COD dropshipping niche with years of ad exposure, driving high CPMs and creative fatigue
risks.mitigation: Differentiate with a unique Arabic-language angle or bundle rather than generic fajas creative

risks.risk: Sizing failure is endemic to shapewear (body-type variance); wrong-size COD orders drive high door-refusal and return rates
risks.mitigation: Publish a detailed Arabic size chart and confirm size by chat before dispatch

risks.risk: Body-contouring shapewear creative routinely triggers Meta's body-image / before-after ad policy rejections
risks.mitigation: Avoid before/after and skin-tight body shots; use product-only or loose-fit lifestyle imagery

risks.risk: Near-identical fajas products are sold by many MENA COD dropshippers from the same Alibaba supplier pool, compressing margins
risks.mitigation: Brand or bundle the product rather than competing on price alone

risks.risk: Publicly advertising a body-shaping garment on mainstream Facebook/Instagram feeds in a socially conservative market may draw negative comments or limit organic reach
risks.mitigation: Use modest, fabric-focused creative and consider female-skewed audience/placement targeting

risks.risk: A 100-unit batch split across multiple sizes multiplies unsold-stock risk if the size mix doesn't match actual demand
risks.mitigation: Weight the initial batch toward the most common sizes based on general size-distribution norms

P02.top_risk: Structural niche saturation combined with sizing-driven COD return/refusal rates is the dominant risk.

risks.risk: Underlying product could be a skin-care device, cleaner, humidifier, or hair dryer - each with a different battery/liquid/certification profile; ordering the wrong sub-type wastes the batch
risks.mitigation: Request exact listing photos/spec sheet from the supplier and confirm the sub-category before ordering

risks.risk: If the device is battery-powered, lithium batteries are restricted for air freight without special dangerous-goods handling, forcing slower/costlier sea freight
risks.mitigation: Confirm battery presence and required freight mode with the forwarder before booking shipping

risks.risk: Electrical/beauty devices commonly require electrical safety documentation for import; missing paperwork risks customs delay or seizure
risks.mitigation: Request CE/RoHS-equivalent documentation from the supplier prior to shipment

risks.risk: If marketed as a beauty/skin device, efficacy claims (e.g. 'removes wrinkles', 'deep cleans pores') are restricted under Meta's health-claims ad policy
risks.mitigation: Use descriptive, non-medical claims only in Arabic ad copy

risks.risk: Wholesale price uncertainty across candidate sub-types (roughly $2-$15/unit) makes 100-unit capital budgeting unreliable
risks.mitigation: Get a firm quote on the exact confirmed listing before committing spend

P03.top_risk: Fundamental product-identity ambiguity blocks reliable shipping, legal, and marketing planning.

risks.mitigation: Time import and ad launch to land before Mother's Day and reposition remaining stock as a generic gift afterward

risks.risk: Gold plating wears/tarnishes with normal wear, causing post-delivery complaints and disputes over 'defective' product in a COD model
risks.mitigation: Use a higher-micron plating supplier and set clear 'gold-plated, not solid gold' expectations in the ad

risks.risk: Marketing a gold-plated item as '18K Gold' risks Meta ad rejection or takedown for misleading composition/quality claims

risks.risk: Generic gold-plated fashion jewelry is a commoditized, easily-sourced product line carried by many dropshippers

risks.risk: A narrow seasonal window combined with a 100-unit commitment risks dead stock if China-to-Libya shipping timing slips past the date

risks.risk: Gift jewelry is evergreen but heavily advertised by many competitors, raising ad costs over time

risks.risk: Low per-unit cost keeps capital lock for 100 units relatively small, but with no strong seasonal anchor, unsold stock can linger without a clearance trigger
